blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Training LLM agents with reinforcement learning (RL) is bottlenecked by environments, which must provide verifiable rewards, support long-horizon interaction, and scale cheaply.
Existing approaches rely on costly human-curated data or on LLM-generated environments that risk hallucinations and benchmark contamination.
We show that LLMs can instead be trained into capable search agents using synthetic environments generated entirely by rules, whose generation requires no LLM and has zero marginal cost.
We build PhantomEnvironments, multi-turn RL environments from fictional worlds, where agents must search a corpus of templated articles to answer multi-hop questions.
Despite sharing no facts with the real world, these strikingly simple environments yield agents that transfer to real-world multi-hop search benchmarks, often outperforming real-world training data on newer benchmarks.
Trained agents generalize to unseen fictional universes, and Qwen models learn to scale their search budget roughly linearly with question difficulty, suggesting emergent search scaling from environment interaction alone.
Ablating environment complexity reveals that hop count drives transfer more than constraints or comparisons: even the simplest rule-generated environments are a surprisingly effective, free resource for training generalizable LLM agents.
blocks.zh:
通过强化学习(RL)培训LLM代理商受到环境的束缚,环境必须提供可核查的奖励,支持长视距互动,并低价规模.
现有方法依赖昂贵的经人验证的数据或LLM产生的环境,这些环境有产生幻觉和基准污染的风险。
我们显示,LLMS可以被训练成有能力的搜索代理商,使用完全由规则产生的合成环境,其生成不需要LLM,其边际成本为零.
我们从虚构的世界构建了幻影环境,多变的RL环境, 特工们必须搜索一批模板化的文章来回答多跳的问题。
尽管与现实世界没有任何事实可言,但这些惊人的简单环境产生了向现实世界的多跳搜索基准转移的代理商,往往比较新的基准的实际世界培训数据要好。
被训练的特工一般化到看不见的虚构宇宙中,而Quen模型则学习大致用问题难度线性地放大他们的搜索预算,建议仅从环境相互作用中就出现搜索规模.
模拟环境的复杂性表明,hop计数驱动的转移不仅仅是限制或比较:即使是最简单的规则生成环境,也是用于培训通用LLM代理的令人惊讶的有效和自由的资源.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Training LLM search agents with reinforcement learning (RL) is bottlenecked by environment curation.
RL needs an environment the agent can interact with: one that yields long multi-turn trajectories, a verifiable reward at the end of each one, and multiple interactions.
Building such environments at scale for RL is expensive.
Wikipedia-grounded environments built from human-curated corpora like NaturalQuestions and HotpotQA require costly annotation and could tie the agent to a fixed Wikipedia snapshot ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ; Yang et al., 2018 ; Jin et al., 2025b ) .
LLM-synthesized environments use frontier models to create retrievals, questions, or whole task harnesses ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Goldie et al., 2025 ; Chang et al., 2026 ; Gandhi et al., 2026 ; Sullivan et al., 2025 ) .
They reduce curation effort, but they introduce hallucinated rewards, benchmark contamination risk, API cost, and a capability ceiling set by the generator.
The bottleneck in training LLM agents has shifted from optimization to the question of where verifiable, interactive, long-horizon environments should come from.
blocks.zh:
训练LLM搜索员的强化学习(RL)因环境培养而瓶颈.
RL需要一种代理人可以与之互动的环境:一种产生长长的多转轨迹的环境,一种在每一转尾可核查的奖励,以及多种相互作用.
大规模建立此类可再生能源环境的费用高昂。
维基百科上的基础环境由自然问题和热点QA等人造化的蝎子构建,需要代价高昂的注释,并且可以将代理与维基百科上的固定快照联系起来(Kwiatkowski等人,2019年;杨等人,2018年;Jin等人,2025年b).
LLM-合成环境利用前沿模型来创建检索,提问,或整个任务牵引(Sun等人,2025年;Gao等人,2025年;Wu等人,2026年;Goldie等人,2025年;Chang等人,2026年;Gandhi等人,2026年;Sullivan等人,2025年).
它们减少了管理努力,但采用了幻觉奖励、基准污染风险、API成本和发电机设定的能力上限。
培训LLM代理商的瓶颈已从优化转向了可核查、互动、长视野环境应来自何处的问题。

blocks.en:
We show that such an environment for training LLM agents can be designed by codified rules alone , with no humans and no LLMs in the pipeline.
We turn fictional worlds and template-generated multi-hop questions of PhantomWiki ( Gong et al., 2025 ) into interactive multi-turn environments for RL fine-tuning LLMs, which we call PhantomEnvironments (PhantomEnvs for short).
Such “rule-generated synthetic environments” are verifiable by construction and incur zero generation cost.
Universe size, question difficulty, and question budget are knobs the experimenter sets directly, so such environments can scale to arbitrary sizes and complexity.
blocks.zh:
我们表明,培训LLM代理商的这种环境可以仅仅通过成文规则来设计,没有人类和LLMs的管道。
我们把虚构的世界和模板生成的PhantomWiki的多跳问题(Gong et al., 2025)变成RL微调LLMs的互动多翻环境,我们称之为PhantomEnvs(PhantomEnvs for short).
这种“规则产生的合成环境”可通过建造加以核查,并产生零生产成本。
宇宙大小,问题难度,和问题预算是实验者直接设置的节点,因此这样的环境可以缩放到任意大小和复杂性.

blocks.en:
A priori, there is little reason to expect simple synthetic environments to work.
Fictional universes in these rule-generated synthetic environments share no entities, no facts, and no document distribution with any real-world benchmark.
Articles are template-generated rather than human-written and the relational structure is a randomly sampled social graph—neither the linguistic richness nor the long-tailed topical structure of real-world corpora like Wikipedia.
An agent trained here has no facts to memorize and no exposure to the linguistic variation it will face at evaluation, so the default expectation is that whatever it learns stays coupled to the templates and fails to transfer.
Any transfer that does occur due to PhantomEnvironments must come from learning generalizable agentic search skills —decomposing questions, retrieving documents correctly, composing knowledge across turns.
blocks.zh:
先验地说,没有什么理由期望简单的合成环境起作用.
这些规则生成的合成环境中的虚构宇宙没有实体,没有事实,也没有带有任何现实世界基准的文件发行.
文章是模板生成而非人文写作,关系结构是随机抽取的社会图表——无论是语言的丰富性,还是像维基百科那样现实世界的长尾主题结构.
一位在这里受过训练的特工没有可以记住的事实,也没有接触过其在评价时将面临的语言变异,所以默认的预期是,无论他学到什么,都会与模板结合,无法转移.
由于“幽灵环境”而发生的任何转移必须来自学习一般的代理搜索技能——解答问题、正确检索文件、汇集知识。

blocks.zh: 图1:在幽灵环境转移到现实世界搜索方面接受RL培训的LLM特工.

blocks.en:
Yet, we empirically demonstrate significant and consistent transfer to real-world agentic search.
We RL full fine-tune four LLMs (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Team, 2024 ) , Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Phi-4-mini-instruct ( Microsoft et al., 2025 ) ) inside PhantomEnvironments and evaluate on a suite of six real-world multi-hop search benchmarks.
Performance improves over the base model by roughly 1.7 × 1.7\times on the Wikipedia-2018-based benchmarks (HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) , 2WikiMultihopQA ( Ho et al., 2020 ) , MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) ) and 2.2 × 2.2\times on the newer-and-harder ones (SynthWorlds-RM, SynthWorlds-SM ( Gu et al., 2025 ) and FRAMES ( Krishna et al., 2025 ) ).
We also find that trained Qwen models learn to allocate their search budget roughly linearly with question difficulty—an emergent search scaling behavior.
To our knowledge, we are the first to show that off-the-shelf LLMs fine-tuned with RL on such rule-generated synthetic environments can create LLM search agents performant in the real-world.
blocks.zh:
然而,我们实证地证明了向现实世界代理搜索的重大和持续转移。
我们RL完全微调4个LLM(Quen2.5-3B-指令,Quen2.5-7B-指令(团队,2024年),Llama-3.2-3B-指令(Grattafiori等人,2024年),Phi-4-mini-指令). (Microsoft等人,2025年)在幽灵环境内部,并评价一套包含6个现实世界的多跳搜索基准.
在基于Wikipedia-2018的基准(HotpotQA(Yang等人,2018年),2Wiki MultihopQA(Ho等人,2020年),MuSi)上,业绩比基准模型提高了大约1.7×1.7\时. Que(Trivedi等人,2022年)和2.2 × 2.2\times on the new-and-harder (SynthWorlds-RM,SynthWorlds-SM (Gu等人,2025年)和FRAMES (Krishna等人,2025年)).
我们还发现训练有素的Quen模型学会了大致线性地分配他们的搜索预算,并带有问题难度——一种突发的搜索缩放行为.
据我们所知,我们第一个显示,在这种规则产生的合成环境中,用RL进行微调的现成LLMs可以创造LLM搜索代理在现实世界中的表现者.

blocks.en:
Transfer alone, however, does not tell us how fictional worlds compare to real training data.
Head-to-head against Search-R1-style training in a real Wikipedia-2018 environment, the real-world environment (expectedly) wins on the in-domain Wikipedia-2018 benchmarks.
On benchmarks built from more recent Wikipedia snapshots, however, its advantage narrows for every model and disappears for Qwen models.
The cleanest evidence comes from the SynthWorlds real-vs-synthetic-mirror pair: training with real-world data preserves and even widens the gap between SynthWorlds-RM and SynthWorlds-SM evaluation, while training in PhantomEnvironments closes it.
The real environment lets the agent shortcut through memorized Wikipedia facts, whereas the fictional one denies that route and forces models to learn and apply the fundamental search skill.
blocks.zh:
然而,光是转让并不能告诉我们虚构的世界如何与真正的培训数据相比较。
在真实的维基百科-2018环境中,对阵Search-R1风格的训练,现实世界环境(预期)在域内维基百科-2018基准上获胜.
然而,在最近维基百科的快照所建立的基准上,它的优势对每一个模型都缩小,对Quen模型则消失.
最干净的证据来自SynthWorlds real-vs-synthetic-mirror配对:使用现实世界数据进行训练可以保存甚至扩大SynthWorlds-RM和SynthWorlds-SM评价之间的差距,而Phantom Environments的训练可以关闭.
真实的环境让代理捷径通过记忆维基百科的事实,而虚构的一条则否认这条路线,迫使模型学习和应用基本的搜索技能.

blocks.en:
As generation is rule-based, we can also vary the question distribution to isolate which axes of environment complexity drive transfer.
We design three training environments: linear hop questions, hops compared by attribute, and hops constrained by attribute filters.
We observe that linear hops carry most of the transfer, while comparison questions specifically improve matching real-world comparison questions.
We observe larger gains where the base model is weakest, suggesting a modular path for addressing model capability gaps by composing environment complexities.
Constraint questions, counterintuitively, hurt: agents learn to retrieve gold documents with a single verbatim query that exploits rare attributes.
This causes the models to skip question decomposition entirely, a necessary skill for real-world agentic search.
Environment complexity axes thus do not blindly compose—they help when they match real-world question types and can backfire when they reward shortcuts.
blocks.zh:
由于生成是基于规则的,我们也可以改变问题分布,以隔离环境复杂度驱动转移的哪些轴.
我们设计三种训练环境:线性hop问题,按属性比较hop,和受属性过滤器制约hop.
我们看到线性跳动携带了大部分的转录,而比较问题则具体改善了匹配现实世界比较问题.
我们观察到,在基准模型最弱的地方,收益更大,这表明,通过将环境复杂性混为一谈来解决模型能力差距的模块化途径。
约束性问题,反直觉性,伤害性:特工们学会用一个利用稀有属性的单逐字记录查询来检索黄金文档.
这导致模型完全跳过问题分解,这是现实世界代理搜索的必要技能.
因此,环境复杂性轴不会盲目地编曲——当它们与现实世界的问题类型相匹配时,它们会有所帮助,当它们奖励捷径时,它们会起反作用。

blocks.en:
Together, these results position rule-generated synthetic environments as a new source of agent training data, complementary to human-curated and LLM-generated ones.
Each brings something the others cannot: human-curated environments contribute linguistic richness and in-domain evaluation coverage, LLM-synthesized environments enable targeted task design at lower curation effort.
Rule-generated environments add what neither can: training signal for RL that is zero-marginal-cost, exactly verifiable, and never goes stale.
The promise comes with limitations—they lag on in-domain benchmarks where knowledge memorization helps, and must be designed to avoid reward shortcuts.
The core finding stands: environments built from rules alone train capable LLM search agents.
blocks.zh:
这些结果共同将规则生成的合成环境定位为新的物剂培训数据来源,与人测度和LLM生成的数据相辅相成.
每一种环境都带来其他环境所无法做到的:人造环境有助于语言丰富和域内评价范围,LLM合成环境使得目标任务设计能够降低校准工作。
规则生成的环境添加了同样无法做到的: 零边际成本,精确可核查的RL训练信号,永不停滞.
承诺是有限制的——它们落后于知识记忆有助于实现的域内基准,必须避免奖励捷径。
核心发现站:仅凭规则构建的环境就训练出有能力的LLM搜索代理.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Reinforcement Learning for LLM Search Agents. Following the success of outcome-based RL for reasoning in LLMs ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , a line of work has trained LLM search agents to interleave retrieval with chain-of-thought.
Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) pairs a Wikipedia index with exact-match rewards; follow-ups vary the optimization but not the data source, exploring multi-stage training ( Song et al., 2025 ) , tighter reasoning–retrieval coupling ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , live web environments ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , step-level reward shaping ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and modular designs ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) .
In this work, we compare the two extremes of synthetic-real environment spectrum: our rule-generated synthetic environments vs the real-world NQ+HotpotQA (multi-hop questions referencing the Wikipedia 2018 corpus ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ; Yang et al., 2018 ) ).
We treat the environment as the design surface and ask which axes of question complexity drive transfer.
blocks.zh:
强化LLM搜索代理的学习. 在LLMs中基于结果的RL推理成功(Guo等人,2025年)后,一行工作培训了LLM搜索人员将检索与思维链进行互换.
Search-R1(Jin等人,2025b)将维基百科的索引配对为精确匹配的奖赏;后续则会改变优化而不是数据源,探索多阶段培训(Song等人,2025),更紧密的推理-检索组合(Chen等人,2025b),直播网络环境(郑等人,2025),步级奖励塑造(Wang等人,2025),模块设计(Jiang等人,2025).
在这部作品中,我们比较了合成-真实环境频谱的两个极端: 我们的规则生成的合成环境与现实世界NQQ HotpotQA(多跳问题参考维基百科2018年教程(Kwiatkowski等人,2019年;杨等人,2018年)).

blocks.en:
Synthetic Environment Design for Agent Training. To reduce the time and cost of hand-curating RL training environments at scale, recent work uses LLMs to synthesize training data: either by simulating retrieval responses ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , by generating QA pairs and multi-step trajectories ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Goldie et al., 2025 ; Chang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) , or by creating full task harnesses for agents ( Gandhi et al., 2026 ) .
While LLMs can generate synthetic training data at scale, they introduce hallucination risk and potential benchmark contamination, from real-world knowledge memorized during LLM training.
Creating every training data point incurs non-trivial API cost.
Moreover, LLM-generated data is subject to the LLM’s capability ceiling.
blocks.zh:
代理培训的合成环境设计. 为了大规模减少人工校准RL培训环境的时间和成本,近期的工作利用LLMs合成培训数据:要么模拟检索反应(Sun等人,2025年),生成QA对和多步轨迹(Gao等人,2025年;Wu等人,2026年;Goldie等人,2025年;Chang等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年;Lu等人,2025年),要么为物剂创造全任务利用率(Gandhi等人,2026年)。
虽然LLMS能够产生规模的合成培训数据,但它们引入了幻觉风险和潜在基准污染,从在LLM培训中记住的现实世界知识.
创建每一个培训数据点都会产生非部落性API成本.
此外,LLM生成的数据受LLM能力上限的限制。

blocks.en:
A parallel pre-LLM tradition generates training environments procedurally through rules, entirely free of LLMs.
BabyAI ( Chevalier-Boisvert et al., 2019 ) established the rule-generated paradigm in gridworlds; RandomWorld ( Sullivan et al., 2025 ) more recently applies type-guided sampling to synthesize tool-use API call sequences—though it still relies on an LLM to populate environment values and instructions.
Both show transfer to real-world benchmarks.
On the evaluation front, PhantomWiki ( Gong et al., 2025 ) , SynthWorlds ( Gu et al., 2025 ) , GSM- ∞ \infty ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) use rule-generated fictional worlds to measure LLM reasoning separately from memorized knowledge.
Closest to our setting, Kabra et al. (2026) and Stojanovski et al. (2025) train on rule-generated synthetic data and show transfer to real-world reasoning.
However, they are limited to the much simpler in-context reasoning setting, where all relevant documents are supplied in the prompt, and LLMs need only compose knowledge ( Kabra et al., 2026 ) .
The agentic reasoning setting we study is substantially harder: the LLM receives only the question and no documents upfront.
It must (1) discover the relevant documents by formulating queries, (2) recover from irrelevant retrievals from the environment, and finally (3) compose knowledge across many environment interactions.
We build on PhantomWiki to an interactive multi-turn RL environment, with no humans or LLMs anywhere in the environment generation pipeline, and exact Prolog-grounded verifiability ( Table 1 ) ( Sterling & Shapiro, 1994 ) .
These PhantomEnvironments are thus zero-marginal-cost for generating data.
Moreover, their complexity design is controllable rather than being set by an LLM’s capabilities.
blocks.zh:
平行的LLM前传统通过规则在程序上产生培训环境,完全没有LLM.
BabyAI(Chevalier-Boisvert等人,2019年)在网格世界中建立了规则生成的范式;RandomWorld(Sullivan等人,2025年)最近应用了类型制导的采样来合成工具使用API的调用序列——虽然它仍然依赖于LLM来填充环境值和指令.
两者都显示了向现实世界基准的转移.
在评价方面,PhantomWiki(龚等人,2025年),SynthWorlds(Gu等人,2025年),GSM-Q&infty(周等人,2025年)使用规则产生的虚构世界来分别测量LLM推理与记忆知识.
最接近我们的设定,Kabra等人(2026年)和Stojanovski等人(2025年)乘坐规则生成的合成数据列车,并显示向现实世界推理的转移.
然而,它们仅限于简单得多的内文推理设置,即时提供所有相关文件,而LLMs只需要作曲知识(Kabra等人,2026年).
我们研究的代理推理环境要困难得多:LLM只收到问题,没有文件摆在前面.
它必须(1)通过提出询问来发现相关文件,(2)从不相关的环境检索中恢复,最后(3)通过许多环境相互作用来形成知识。
我们利用PhantomWiki建立一个互动的多转式RL环境,在环境生成管道中没有任何人类或LLMs,而且精确的Prolog定位可核查性(表1)(Sterling & Shapiro,1994年)。
因此,这些幽灵环境是产生数据的零边际成本。
此外,它们的复杂性设计是可以控制的,而不是由LLM的能力来设定的.

blocks.en:
Multi-Hop Reasoning and Retrieval. Multi-hop question answering, requiring evidence chains across multiple documents, has been the dominant testbed for retrieval-augmented reasoning.
A series of increasingly controlled benchmarks—HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) , 2WikiMultihopQA ( Ho et al., 2020 ) , and MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) —has driven progress on this task, each tightening controls against reasoning shortcuts.
SynthWorlds ( Gu et al., 2025 ) and FRAMES ( Krishna et al., 2025 ) pose harder variants requiring integration across more sources under complex constraints.
On the method side, IRCoT ( Trivedi et al., 2023 ) showed that interleaving retrieval with reasoning beats single-shot retrieval, with later work regulating retrieval through reflection tokens ( Asai et al., 2023 ) or graph-organized corpora ( Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ) .
ReAct introduced the agentic search setting: agents reason to retrieve information with search queries to a search engine requirement ( Yao et al., 2022 ) .
These methods collectively underscore that effective multi-hop search requires tight coupling between retrieval and reasoning at each step—precisely the skill our synthetic environments are designed to elicit, without relying on any real-world factual content.
blocks.zh:
多霍普理性与检索. 多跳问题回答需要跨越多个文件的证据链,一直是检索-强化推理的主要试验床。
一系列越来越受控制的基准——HotpotQA(Yang等人,2018年),2Wiki MultihopQA (Ho等人,2020年),和MuSiQue(Trivedi等人,2022年)——推动在这项任务上取得进展,各自针对推理捷径加强控制.
SynthWorlds(Gu等人,2025年)和FRAMES(Krishna等人,2025年)在复杂的制约下造成更难的变体,需要更多来源的融合.
在方法方面,IRCoT(Trivedi等人,2023年)显示,与推理的交叉检索比单发检索要好,以后的工作通过反射符调节检索(Asai等人,2023年)或图形排列的corpora. (Gutiérrez等人,2024年).
ReAct引入了代理搜索设置:代理商有理由通过搜索查询检索到搜索引擎要求的信息(姚等人,2022年).
这些方法集体地强调,有效的多跳搜索需要在每个步骤的检索和推理之间紧密结合——确切地说,我们合成环境的设计是为了获得的技能,而不依赖于任何现实世界的事实内容。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 PhantomEnvironments for Agent Training
blocks.zh: 3.1 代理培训的幽灵环境

blocks.en:
Training search agents with RL requires environments that provide verifiable rewards and support long-horizon trajectories.
Rather than relying on human- or LLM-curated data, we build on PhantomWiki ( Gong et al., 2025 ) , a rule-generated synthetic dataset consisting of multi-hop question-answer pairs about fictional people—these worlds contain no real-world facts.
Fresh synthetic datasets can be generated with varying sizes, hop count, number of questions, and question difficulty.
blocks.zh:
培训使用RL的搜索人员需要提供可核查的奖励和支持长视轨的环境.
我们不是依靠人或LLM精准数据,而是依靠PhantomWiki(Gong et al., 2025年),这是一个规则生成的合成数据集,由关于虚构人物的多跳问答组合组成——这些世界没有包含现实世界的事实.
新鲜的合成数据集可以生成大小不一,跳计数,问题数,以及问题难度.

blocks.en:
In these fictional worlds, people are connected through family and friendship relationships; articles about people are generated with programmed templates.
Questions are generated with context-free grammars, and every question-answer pair is fully verifiable by construction.
Concretely, we sample relational chains of up to 7 linear hops over the underlying graph from the grammar ( the sister of the friend of the parent of Alice ).
Each sampled question compiles to a parallel Prolog query that returns ground-truth answers; a question can have multiple answers.
See Section A.4 for details.
blocks.zh:
在这些虚构的世界中,人们通过家庭和友谊的关系互相联系;关于人的文章用程序模板生成.
提问用无上下文语法产生,每对答题通过构造可以完全核实.
具体地说,我们从语法(爱丽丝父母的朋友的妹妹)的下图上对多达7个线性跳动的亲缘链进行取样.
每个抽样问题汇编到一个并行的Prolog查询,以返回地面真实答案;一个问题可以有多个答案.
详情见A.4节。

blocks.en:
We collect all templated articles of individuals in a fictional world into a search index, turning PhantomWiki into a search environment where documents can be retrieved by querying.
The retrieval interface matches the real-world search setting; only the underlying documents are fictional and rule-generated.
This enables an agent to learn—in fictional worlds—how to issue targeted queries and compose knowledge across multiple turns.
blocks.zh:
我们收集了虚构世界中个人的所有模板文章成为搜索索引,将PhantomWiki变成一个通过查询可以检索文件的搜索环境.
检索界面符合现实世界的搜索设置;只有基础文档是虚构的和规则生成的.
这使一个代理人能够学习——在虚构的世界中——如何发出有针对性的查询,并在多个回合中形成知识。

blocks.en: 3.2 Training LLMs as Search Agents
blocks.zh: 3.2 作为搜索代理人培训法学硕士

blocks.en:
We follow the RL fine-tuning recipe of Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) to train models for agentic search, instructing them to use XML tags <search>...</search> for queries and <answer>...</answer> for final answers, with retrieved results appended in <information>...</information> . Trajectories terminate when the model outputs a final answer, reaches the max turn limit, or fails to generate these tags.
All details are in Appendix A ).
blocks.zh:
我们遵循Search-R1(Jin等人,2025年b)的RL微调配方,以培训代理搜索模式,指示他们使用XML标记 <search>.</search>进行查询,最后回答则使用 <surch>.</answer>,检索结果附在 < information>.</inform>中。 当模型输出一个最终答案,达到最大转弯极限,或者无法生成这些标记时,轨迹终止.
所有详情见附录A。

blocks.en:
GRPO and reward design. We use the GRPO algorithm where the model generates multiple independent trajectories for a question and is rewarded only on the final answer ( Shao et al., 2024 ) .
Following standard practice in RL fine-tuning, we mask out environment’s outputs within <information>...</information> when calculating the GRPO objective to update the model’s weights ( Jin et al., 2025b ) .
We train on ≈ \approx 55K questions in our synthetic environments.
To compare with real-world training data, we randomly subsample 55K questions (same data budget) from the NaturalQuestions-HotpotQA (NQ+HotpotQA) corpus released with Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) .
A question in PhantomEnvironments can have multiple ground-truth answers and an LLM can output multiple predictions separated by commas, so we use the F1 score for reward, after SQuAD-style text normalization ( Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ) .
When questions have 1 final answer, as is the case for NQ+HotpotQA questions, the F1 score reward is the same as Exact Match reward.
blocks.zh:
GPRO和奖励设计. 我们使用GRPO算法,该模型为一个问题生成多个独立的轨道,并且只在最终答案上得到奖励(Shao等人,2024年).
按照RL微调的标准做法,我们掩盖了“信息”中的环境产出。 (jin等人,2025年b)。
我们在合成环境中训练大约55K题
为了与现实世界的训练数据进行比较,我们随机抽取与Search-R1(Jin等人,2025b)一起发布的自然问题-HotpotQA(NQQA)的55K问题(相同的数据预算)进行子样本。
Phantom Environments中一个问题可以有多个地面真实的答案,一个LLM可以输出多个以逗号分隔的预测,所以我们使用F1的分数来奖励,在SQuAD风格的文本正常化之后(Rajpurkar等人,2016年).
当问题有1个最终答案时,如NQQQHotpotQA问题,F1分数奖励与Exact Match奖励相同.

blocks.en:
Training details. We fix the training setup so that any difference in transfer is attributable to only the training environment.
To encode documents of each environment and search queries, we use intfloat/e5-base-v2 model ( Wang et al., 2022 ) for dense retriever with a flat FAISS index, and fetch top-3 documents per query ( Johnson et al., 2019 ) .
We RL full fine-tune four LLMs of different families and sizes: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, and Phi-4-mini-instruct ( Team, 2024 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Microsoft et al., 2025 ) .
We train every setting for 1 epoch, with 2 independent training seeds, in our compute budget of 2 B200s over 2 days.
Throughout evaluation results in Section 4 we compute mean and standard errors on both training seeds.
We use the open-source SkyRL library ( Cao et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
培训详情。 我们确定培训设置,以便任何转移方面的差异都只能归因于培训环境。
为了编码每个环境的文件和搜索查询,我们使用intfloat/e5-base-v2模型(Wang等人,2022年)来使用一个平坦的FAISS指数进行密集的检索,并获取每个查询的顶级-3文档(Johnson等人,2019年).
我们调整了四个不同家庭和大小的法学硕士学位: Quen2.5-3B-指令,Quen2.5-7B-指令,Llama-3.2-3B-指令,和Phi-4-mini-指令(Team,2024;Grattafiori等人,2024;Microsoft等人,2025).
我们在计算2B200s的预算时,用2个独立训练种子,为1个世纪进行每个设置的培训。
在整个评价结果第4节中,我们计算出两种培训种子的平均值和标准误差。
使用开源SkyRL图书馆(曹 al等,2025年).

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价基准

blocks.en:
We evaluate across Wikipedia-based benchmarks capturing different facets of multi-hop search: standard 2–4 multi-hop datasets (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue), newer 2–6 hop benchmarks to disentangle memorization and reasoning (SynthWorlds-RM, SynthWorlds-SM), and a harder benchmark requiring longer reasoning chains of 2–15 hops (FRAMES).
Wikipedia reference articles of these benchmarks span across LLM knowledge cutoff dates.
For HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, and SynthWorlds-RM, we use 500 evaluation questions from ( Kabra et al., 2026 ) ; for SynthWorlds-SM, we use the 500 synthetic-mirror counterparts of SynthWorlds-RM; and for FRAMES, all 824 questions with June 2023 Wikipedia articles using the specified URLs.
We additionally use 500 questions of CofCA ( Wu et al., 2024 ) benchmark for our ablation on environment complexities ( Section 5 ).
Details in Section A.5 .
blocks.zh:
我们通过基于维基百科的基准来评估多跳搜索的不同方面:标准2–4多跳数据集(HotpotQA,2Wiki MultihopQA,MuSiQue),较新的2–6多跳基准来分解记忆和推理(SynthWorlds-RM,SynthWorlds-SM),以及更难的基准要求2–15多跳链(FRAMES)更长的推理链.
这些基准的维基百科参考文章跨越LLM知识截止日期.
对于HotpotQA,2Wiki MultihopQA,MuSiQue,和SynthWorlds-RM,我们使用来自(Kabra等人,2026年)的500个评价问题;对于SynthWorlds-SM,我们使用SynthWorlds-RM的500个合成-mirror对应物;对于FRAMES,所有824个问题都使用2023年6月的维基百科文章使用指定的URL.
此外,我们还使用了500个关于CofCA(Wu等人,2024年)的基准问题,作为我们对环境复杂性的考虑(第5节)。
A.5节详细情况

blocks.en:
Evaluation setup. Each benchmark contributes its own retrieval corpus—built from the gold reference and distractor paragraphs accompanying each question.
For FRAMES, we use section-level chunks of the Wikipedia reference articles.
We report token-level F1 score for these real-world benchmarks, computed with the canonical SQuAD-based scorer of each benchmark (HotpotQA-style yes/no/noanswer guard for HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, and CofCA; MuSiQue-style F1 scoring otherwise).
At evaluation time we use a retriever setup of the maximum 32768 context limit, up to 20 turns, and the Qwen3-Embedding-4B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) dense retriever—this setup is superior to our training setup.
Following prior work ( Jin et al., 2025a ) , we find that this superior evaluation configuration yields better reported benchmark performance for all LLMs, trained or otherwise.
See Tables 4 and 5 in Section A.3 for ablation results on retriever choice.
blocks.zh:
评价设置. 每个基准都提供自己的检索资料,这些资料来自每个问题所附的黄金参考和分散注意力的段落。
对于FRAMES,我们使用维基百科参考文章的分区级块.
我们报告这些现实世界基准的标志级F1得分,用每个基准(HotpotQA-style yes/no/noanswer guard for HotpotQA, 2Wiki MultihopQA, 和 CofCA; MuSiQue-style F1-syst)的Cononcial SQuAD的计分员计算。
在评估时,我们使用一个检索器设置,最多可达20个转弯,而Qune3-Embedding-4B(Zhang等人,2025年)密集检索器——这个设置比我们的训练设置要优越.
继先前的工作(Jin等人,2025年a)之后,我们发现,这一优异的评价配置对所有受过培训或其他培训的有限责任公司来说,报告的基准业绩较好。
A.3节表4和表5列出回收商选择的消耗结果。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Performance Transfer from PhantomEnvs to Real-World Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 幻影的性能转移 现实世界评价的内涵

blocks.en:
Table 2: F1 scores on real-world agentic search benchmarks after RL fine-tuning in PhantomEnvironments. Synthetic training significantly improves performance of all LLM families and sizes.
Improvements are largest on the newer and harder benchmarks—SynthWorlds-RM, SynthWorlds-SM, and FRAMES—Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct improves by up to 7.1 × 7.1\times on SynthWorlds-SM.
We report mean ± \pm standard error over the test sets and two training seeds.
blocks.zh:
表2:在幽灵环境RL微调后,F1在现实世界代理搜索基准上的得分. 合成培训大大提高了所有LLM家庭和尺寸的性能.
在较新的、较硬的基准上改进幅度最大——合成世界-RM、合成世界-SM和FRAMES-Llama-3.2-3B-Instructionct上改进了最多7.1×7.1\的合成世界-SM。
我们报告测试机和两个训练种子的标准错误

blocks.en:
Table 2 reports the F1 scores on real-world multi-hop agentic search benchmarks before and after RL fine-tuning in PhantomEnvironments.
Training on synthetic environments consistently yields significant gains across all six benchmarks and four LLMs (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Phi-4-mini-instruct).
Relative to the base model, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct improves 7.1 × 7.1\times (from 3.8 3.8 F1 score to 27.0 27.0 on SynthWorlds-SM), and at the minimum by 3.2 × 3.2\times for other benchmarks.
Both Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and the larger Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct improve on average 1.9 × 1.9\times after RL fine-tuning in PhantomEnvironments, so the performance transfer holds when scaling LLM size.
Overall, the gains average 1.7 × 1.7\times F1 on older benchmarks pre-LLM cutoff dates (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue) and 2.2 × 2.2\times on more recent and challenging benchmarks (SynthWorlds-RM, SynthWorlds-SM, and FRAMES): these LLM agents can search in fresh and more difficult real-world settings.
Over the course of synthetic training, models do not overfit to the templated questions and fictional universes, and continue to improve on benchmarks ( Figure 2 ).
Every training question is only seen once, so training steps is a proxy for training samples.
Hence, this shows the benefit of data scaling in LLM agent training.
blocks.zh:
表2报告了在幽灵环境中RL微调前后真实世界多跳代理搜索基准的F1分数.
合成环境培训在所有6个基准和4个法学硕士课程(Quen2.5-3B-Instruct、Quen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct、Phi-4-mini-instruct)中持续取得显著成果。
相对于基准模型,Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct改进了7.1×7.1\时(合成世界-SM的比分从3.8 3.8 F1分提高到27.0 27.0分),其他基准的最低比分为3.2×3.2\时.
Quen2.5-3B-Instruct和较大的Quen2.5-7B-Instruct均在幽灵环境RL微调后平均改善1.9×1.9\的时间,所以在缩放LLM大小时性能转移维持.
总体而言,在LLM之前的截止日期(HotpotQA,2Wiki MultihopQA,MuSiQue)和2.2 × 2.2次(SynthWorlds-RM,SynthWorlds-SM,和FRAMES)中,LLM代理商的平均增益为1.7×1.7\times F1:这些LLM代理商可以在新鲜且更困难的现实世界环境中搜索.
在合成培训过程中,模型并不过于适合模板问题和虚构宇宙,并继续改进基准(图2)。
每个训练问题只见一次,因此训练步骤是训练样本的代名词.
因此,这表明在LLM代理培训中扩大数据的好处。

blocks.en:
Figure 2: F1 scores steadily improve as training progresses. We evaluate intermediate checkpoints of PhantomEnvironments training runs, and observe steady performance improvements across the board: a sharp increase initially then a steady growth.
While some runs saturate, we generally do not see drastic overfitting or collapse to the rule-generated templates of PhantomEnvironments.
We report mean ± \pm standard error as the solid line and shaded region.
blocks.zh:
图2:随着培训的进展,F1分数稳步提高。 我们评价 " 幽灵环境 " 培训的中间检查站,并看到全面的业绩稳步改善:最初急剧增加,然后稳步增长。
虽然有些人是饱和的,但我们一般并不认为“幽灵环境”的规则模板过于适应或崩溃。
我们报告的是 ±\pm 标准错误作为固态线和阴影区域 。

blocks.en:
Robustness to larger-scale deployment with noisy search. When agents are deployed, they encounter larger search environments where corpus documents can overlap and interfere.
In practice, deployment environments can return noisier search results to agent queries than the agents were trained to handle.
This demands for training environments that create agents robust to noisy search and ready for larger-scale deployment—do our PhantomEnvironments meet this bar?
blocks.zh:
强壮到更大的部署 与噪音搜索。 当部署特工时,他们会遇到更大的搜索环境,在这些环境中,犯罪事实文件可以重叠和干扰。
在实际操作中,部署环境可以将噪声搜索结果还给代理查询,而不是由代理处理。
我们的“幽灵环境”是否达到这个标准?

blocks.en:
Table 3: Average F1 scores of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, ablating choice of search corpus. Each benchmark’s questions are answered either against that benchmark’s own corpus, or against a single pooled corpus.
Expectedly, agents perform worse against the pooled corpus but the drop is slight, with or without training.
blocks.zh:
表3:平均F1分 Qwen2.5-7B-指令,编剧选择搜索程序. 每个基准的问题要么根据基准本身的主体,要么根据一个集合体来回答。
预计特工们对集合诉讼的处理会更糟,但下降幅度很小,无论是否经过培训。

blocks.en:
We construct this test scenario by gathering the documents of all six benchmarks into one large pooled search index that simulates noisy search.
The pooled corpus is, at the minimum, 1.5 × 1.5\times the size of FRAMES’ corpus alone, and up to 44 × 44\times for SynthWorlds pair.
Moreover, it contains interfering and near-duplicate documents: (1) Wikipedia passages of HotpotQA and MuSiQue overlap with long FRAMES articles, and (2) SynthWorlds-RM documents compete with SynthWorlds-SM as they are identical except for real vs fictional facts ( Gu et al., 2025 ) .
In Table 3 we ablate agent performance on the choice of retrieval corpus, either benchmark’s own or pooled corpus.
Every agent degrades, but only slightly : the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct base worsens by 1.6 1.6 average F1 score, and the synthetic-trained ones by 1.9 1.9 points (see Tables 6 and 7 for more results).
Indeed, agents trained in simplified fictional worlds are robust to large-scale deployments.
blocks.zh:
我们通过收集所有6个基准的文件来构建这个测试情景,形成一个模拟噪音搜索的大型集合搜索指数。
集合体至少是1.5×1.5倍,
此外,它载有干扰性和近似重复的文件: (1)HotpotQA和MuSiQue的维基百科段落与长篇FRAMES文章重叠,(2)SynthWorlds-RM文档与SynthWorlds-SM竞争,因为除了真实的虚构事实(Gu等人,2025年)之外,它们都是相同的.
在表3中,我们降低代理人在选择检索费方面的业绩,无论是基准本身的还是集合费。
每个剂都降解,但只略微: Quen2.5-7B-指令基差恶化了1.6 1.6平均F1分,合成训练基差1.9分(更多结果见表6和表7).
事实上,在简化的虚构世界中接受过训练的特工人员对大规模部署是强有力的。

blocks.en:
Training evolution and emergent search scaling behavior. In addition to real-world transfer, PhantomEnvironments allow for fine-grained analysis as they are fully verifiable and deterministically generated.
At environment generation time, question difficulties—the number of fictional Wikipedia documents to navigate—is known.
Using this feature, we analyze agents’ performance evolution as RL fine-tuning progresses.
In Figure 3 (left) we find that F1 scores of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct improve on questions of all difficulties as training progresses ( Figure 7 visualizes evolution of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Phi-4-mini-instruct).
However, a key behavioral difference emerges between LLM families: Qwen2.5 ones learn to automatically issue search calls proportional to question difficulty, exhibiting a clear linear relationship.
We call this desirable property “search scaling”, emergent in Qwen2.5 LLMs from environment interaction alone.
Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct shows partial search scaling: number of searches grows linearly with question difficulty, then plateaus.
On the other hand, Phi-4-mini-instruct in Figure 7 does not display any scaling.
This suggests that this property is model-dependent and emergent only for sufficiently capable LLMs.
This finding aligns with prior work on how model baseline capabilities influence benefits from further RL fine-tuning ( Gandhi et al., 2025 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
训练进化和新兴的搜索缩放行为. 除了现实世界的转移外,幽灵环境还允许进行精细分析,因为它们是完全可核查的,具有决定性的产生.
在环境生成时间,质疑困难——导航的虚构维基百科文件数量——是已知的.
我们利用这个功能,分析代理商在RL微调过程中的表现演变。
在图3(左)中,我们发现,随着培训的进展,Quen2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct的F1分数在所有困难问题上都有改善(图7可视化了Quen2.5-3B-Instruct和Phi-4-mini-instruct).
然而,LLM家族之间出现了一个关键的行为差异: Quen2.5人学习自动发布与质疑难度成比例的搜索呼叫,显示出明显的线性关系.
我们称这种理想的财产为“搜索规模”,仅环境互动就出现在Quen2.5 LLMs中。
Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct显示部分搜索缩放:搜索次数随着问题难度线性增长,然后是高原.
另一方面,图7中的Phi-4-mini-interstruction没有显示任何缩放.
这表明,这种财产只适合具有足够能力的有限责任公司,而且只依赖模型。
这一结论与以前关于模型基线能力如何影响进一步调整RL的工作相一致(Gandhi等人,2025年;Yue等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Figure 3: F1 scores and number of search calls as a function of question difficulty (hops). (Left two) We evaluate intermediate training checkpoints on validation questions from the training universe.
As fine-tuning progresses, F1 increases across all difficulty levels for both LLMs (darker lines are higher in scores).
In the lower panels, we plot the number of search calls as a function of question difficulty.
We observe an emergent “search scaling” property in Qwen2.5 models: number of searches scales linearly with environment’s question difficulty.
Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct shows partial search scaling, increasing search calls initially and plateauing. (Right two) We evaluate final checkpoints on an unseen universe of the same size as training (Unseen 1K) and a 10 × 10\times larger universe (Unseen 10K).
F1 scores and search scaling behavior in Unseen universes parallel the Training universe, indicating agents acquired generalizable agentic search skill rather than memorizing facts.
blocks.zh:
图3:F1分数和搜索呼叫次数作为问题难度函数(hops). (左二)我们评价来自训练界的验证问题的中间训练检查站.
随着微调进展,F1在两个LLMs的所有难度级别上都有增加(darker线的分数较高).
在较低的面板中,我们绘制搜索呼叫的次数,作为提问难度的函数.
我们观测到Quen2.5模型中突然出现的“搜索缩放”属性:随着环境问题难度的线性搜索缩放。
Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct显示部分搜索规模,最初增加搜索电话并进行高压. (右二经). 我们评价一个与训练(Un Seenn 1K)和10×10\x10\x大宇宙(Unseen 10K)相同的无形宇宙上的最后检查站。
F1在Unseen宇宙中得分和搜索缩放行为与Training宇宙平行,表示特工获得了通用的代理搜索技能,而不是回忆事实.

blocks.en:
Generalization in unseen environments. One concern with training on a fixed fictional universe is that the LLM could simply memorize the knowledge graph’s facts and retrieve answers by pattern matching.
To test fact memorization, in Figure 3 (right) we evaluate on a freshly-generated unseen environment of the same size (Unseen 1K) and a 10 × 10\times larger universe (Unseen 10K).
These evaluation environments share no factual knowledge overlap with any training data, seen either during pretraining or RL fine-tuning.
The trained agents match their in-domain F1 score performance at every difficulty level, when the universe size is fixed at 1K.
The trend follows at the larger universe of 10K as well, where the performance is slightly worse than Unseen 1K due to the more noisy search environment.
Results for Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Phi-4-mini-instruct in Figure 7 .
Robust performance to unseen environments confirms that LLM search agents have learned the generalizable agentic search skill.
blocks.zh:
在看不见的环境中进行概括。 关于固定虚构宇宙的培训,人们关心的是LLM可以简单地记住知识图的事实,通过图案匹配来获取答案.
为了检验事实记忆,在图3(右)中,我们评价一个同样大小(Unseen 1K)和10×10\x10\x大宇宙(Unseen 10K)的新生的无形环境.
这些评价环境没有与任何培训数据重叠的事实知识,无论是在培训前还是在调整RL时都可以看到。
训练有素的特工们在每一个难度级别上都与其内域F1的分数性能相匹配,此时宇宙大小固定在1K.
趋势也出现在更大的10K宇宙,由于搜索环境更吵闹,其性能比Unseen 1K稍差.
图7中的Quen2.5-3B-指示和Phi-4-mini-指示的结果。
强力表现到看不见的环境证实LLM搜索代理已经学会了通用的代理搜索技巧.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Real-World Training Environments
blocks.zh: 4.2 与现实世界培训环境的比较

blocks.en:
So far we have showed that fictional worlds can teach agentic search.
A natural next question is how their transfer compares to training on real-world data.
We find that real-world training environments—with its linguistic richness and grounded factual knowledge—outperform synthetic when evaluation benchmarks contain in-domain facts to training, e.g. when Wikipedia cutoffs overlap.
When evaluation becomes out-of-domain, however, PhantomEnvironments outperform real-world.
blocks.zh:
迄今为止,我们已经表明,虚构的世界可以教授代理搜索。
一个自然的下一个问题是,他们的转移与现实世界数据培训相比如何。
我们发现,当评价基准包含培训的域内事实时,例如当维基百科的断断面重叠时,现实世界的培训环境——语言丰富和基于事实的知识——将表现综合起来。
然而,当评价变成领域外时,幽灵环境的表现超过了现实世界。

blocks.en:
Real-world environments are superior when in-domain to evaluation. In Figure 4 we compare PhantomEnvironments training against a real-world training environment: NQ+HotpotQA questions from the 2018 Wikidump released with Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) .
Three benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue) share the same Wikipedia 2018 corpus, and overlap in factual knowledge to NQ+HotpotQA training.
Expectedly, when training and evaluation are in-domain, real-world training data outperforms synthetic for all LLMs: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct in Figure 4 (a) gets an average 56.7 % 56.7\% F1 score vs 52.2 % 52.2\% respectively (see Figures 8 , 9 and 10 for other LLM results).
blocks.zh:
现实世界的环境在域内评价时优越. 在图4中,我们将幽灵环境的培训与现实世界的培训环境进行比较:NQQHotpot。 来自2018 Wikidump的QA问题与Search-R1一同发布(Jin等人,2025b).
三个基准(HotpotQA,2Wiki MultihopQA,MuSiQue)共享了相同的维基百科2018程序书目,事实知识与NQQHotpotQA培训重叠.
预计,当培训和评价是内在的时,所有法学硕士课程的实际培训数据都比合成的数据要好:图4(a)中的Quen2.5-3B-Instructiont平均得到56.7%的分数,F1的分数与52.2%的分数分别为52.2分(其他LLM结果见图8、图9和图10)。

blocks.en:
Figure 4: (a) Training Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct on real-world NQ+HotpotQA data outperforms PhantomEnvironments on benchmarks in-domain to NQ+HotpotQA (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue). (b) Whereas PhantomEnvs is better than real-world training on newer and harder out-of-domain benchmarks (SynthWorlds-RM, SynthWorlds-SM, FRAMES). (c) PhantomEnvs teach agents to be equally performant on SynthWorlds pair: F1 scores are similar for RM and SM versions (KA = 0 =0 ), but KA > 0 >0 for the base model and NQ+HotpotQA training.
See text for details.
blocks.zh:
图4:(a) 关于现实世界NQQHotpotQA数据的培训 Qwen2.5-3B-指导 域内基准的幽灵环境优于NQHotpotQA(HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue). (b) 幽灵 信封比现实世界关于更新和更加困难的域外基准(SynthWorlds-RM,SynthWorlds-SM,FRAMES)的培训要好. (c) PhantomEnvs 教代理在合成世界对称上同等表现:对RM和SM版本(KA=0=0)来说,F1分数相似,但对基模和NQQQQXHotpotQA训练来说,KA大于0=0.
详情见文本。

blocks.en:
On newer out-of-domain benchmarks, PhantomEnvironments transfers better. The story changes on SynthWorlds-RM, SynthWorlds-SM, and FRAMES benchmarks that are sourced from Wikipedia post 2023.
NQ+HotpotQA data now has limited factual knowledge overlap, so evaluation is out-of-domain in factual knowledge.
Here PhantomEnvironments outperform real-world data: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct in Figure 4 (b) with PhantomEnvs gets an average 32.1 % 32.1\% F1 score vs 28.4 % 28.4\% .
This suggests that PhantomEnvironments yield LLM agents robust to distribution shift.
We further corroborate this hypothesis with the SynthWorlds pair: SynthWorlds-RM (real Wikidata entities) and SynthWorlds-SM (the same graph re-instantiated with synthetic entities) ( Gu et al., 2025 ) .
This pair calculates a Knowledge Advantage (KA) gap, which is positive when LLMs utilize memorized knowledge from Wikipedia. Figure 4 (c) shows KA gaps for base and trained models.
Base models already exhibit positive KA gap—Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct has 8 % 8\% , and that widens to 11 % 11\% after real-world NQ+HotpotQA training.
Remarkably, our PhantomEnvironments fully close the KA gap to 0 % 0\% .
For other LLMs ( Figures 8 , 9 and 10 ), synthetic can reduce the KA gap when real-world data amplifies it.
blocks.zh:
在较新的领域外基准方面,幽灵环境转移更好。 故事在SynthWorlds-RM,SynthWorlds-SM,以及FRAMES基准上有所变化,这些基准来源于维基百科2023后.
NQQQHotpotQA数据现在的事实知识重叠有限,因此评价在事实知识中是域外的.
这里的幽灵环境优于真实世界的数据:图4(b)中的Quen2.5-3B-Instruct,其中幽灵Envs的平均得分为32.1%=32.1=F1=28.4%=28.4==%.
这表明,幽灵环境使LLM剂在分配转移时具有强性。
我们用合成世界的对称进一步证实了这个假设:合成世界-RM(真正的Wikidata实体)和合成世界-SM(同一图以合成实体重新证实)(Gu等人,2025年).
这对计算了一个知识优势(KA)缺口, 图4(c)显示基础模型和培训模型的KA差距。
基础模型已经显示出正差 KA Wen2.5-3B 指令有8% 8 % , 在现实世界 NQQ 之后, 扩展至11% 11 % 。 热点QA训练.
我们的幽灵环境完全关闭了KA的缺口,
对于其他LLMs(图8,9和10),当现实世界数据放大时,合成可以缩小KA差距.

blocks.en:
This contrast shows the need for training environments that are robust when evaluation targets fall beyond LLM training cutoffs—and our PhantomEnvironments meet this need.
Both human-curated and LLM-generated data are anchored to a timed snapshot of the world, so benchmarks built on later snapshots eventually fall outside their coverage.
Rule-generated synthetic environments are decoupled from this temporal drift, timeless in a way, and robust to knowledge memorization.
In new evaluation environments where such shortcuts through memorization are absent, PhantomEnvironments generalize better than real-world training.
blocks.zh:
这种对比表明,在评价目标超出LLM培训限制时,需要强有力的培训环境,而我们的幽灵环境满足了这一需要。
人测度和LLM生成的数据都基于一个定时的世界快照,因此建立在后来的快照上的基准最终超出了它们的覆盖范围.
规则生成的合成环境与这种时空漂移脱钩,在某种程度上是无时无刻的,并且强健到知识记忆.
在新的评价环境中,没有这种通过记忆实现的捷径,幽灵环境比现实世界的培训更为普遍。

blocks.en: 5 Which Environment Complexity Axes Drive Transfer in Agents?
blocks.zh: 5 哪些环境复杂轴驱动代理传输?

blocks.en:
Real-world questions span a spectrum of complexity, such as requiring multiple hops over entities, comparing and combining parallel hop chains, and filtering candidates by constraints.
We ablate our synthetic environments along three orthogonal axes of complexity: linear hops over entities, comparisons of attributes, and constraints that filter candidates.
Holding the corpus fixed, we generate these synthetic environments by extending PhantomEnvironments generation code, context-free-grammars, and Prolog queries.
We then fine-tune Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct.
blocks.zh:
现实世界的问题涉及一系列复杂问题,例如需要多次跳过实体,比较和结合平行跳链,通过制约过滤候选人.
我们沿着三个复杂的正交轴来减缓我们的合成环境:线性跳过实体,比较属性,以及过滤候选者的限制因素。
拥有固定的元件,我们通过扩展幽灵环境生成代码,无上下文语法和Prolog查询来生成这些合成环境.
然后对Quen2.5-3B-指令和Llama-3.2-3B-指令进行微调。

blocks.en:
The original Hops environment has questions of up to 7 linear hops from an anchor person ( Who is the friend of parent of Alice ) or a tail attribute ( whose hobby is birdwatching ).
The new Hops +Comparisons environment pairs two such chains and adds a comparison predicate to the front ( Who is older, friend of parent of Alice, or sister of Bob? ).
We balance the training mixture to 50–50 between pure-hop and comparison questions.
Finally, the new Hops +Constraints environment inserts up to three attribute filters at arbitrary positions along the chain ( Who is the friend, whose hobby is reading, of parent of Alice? ), with the same 50–50 balance between pure-hop (0–1 filters) and multi-constraint (2–3 filters) questions.
Full specifications are in Section A.4 .
blocks.zh:
最初的Hops环境有来自锚人(谁是爱丽丝的父母的朋友)或尾部属性(其爱好是观鸟)的最多7个线性hop的问题.
新Hops + Comparisons环境将两条这样的链条对齐,并在前面添加一个比较的上游(谁年长,爱丽丝父母的朋友,还是鲍勃的妹妹?).
我们把训练混合到50到50 纯跳和比较问题。
最后,新的Hops + Controlints环境沿链条任意位置插入最多3个属性滤波器(谁是爱丽丝父母的朋友,他的爱好是阅读?),在纯Hop(0–1滤波器)和多约束(2–3滤波器)的问题之间保持相同的50–50平衡.
完整的规格载于A.4节。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Ablation results on synthetic environment complexity axes. We find that Hops is the strongest axis that drives real-world transfer.
blocks.zh: 图5:合成环境复杂轴的偏差结果. 我们发现Hops是驱动现实世界转移的最强轴.

blocks.en:
Not every complexity axis equally drives transfer. One might expect that adding complexity axes only adds to performance transfer.
However, Figure 5 shows otherwise—Hops is at least as good as Hops +Comparisons and Hops +Constraints, so linear hops is the dominant complexity axis for performance transfer.
blocks.zh:
并非每个复杂轴都同样驱动传输. 人们可能会期望,增加复杂性轴只会增加性能转移。
然而,图5显示的是其他情况: Hops至少与Hops + Comparisons和Hops + Controlints一样好,因此线性hop是性能转移的主要复杂轴.

blocks.en:
Where exactly do the complexity axes help or hurt? Aggregate F1 scores obscure behavioral changes in agents introduced by environment variants.
In Figures 6 and 11 we decompose performance by question category on CofCA and 2WikiMultihopQA benchmarks, which contain category labels for questions (see Section A.6 for details on category labels).
Both have comparison questions, which our respective environments Hops +Comparisons and Hops +Constraints directly target.
We note three observations.
First, comparison training questions targets the matching real-world category: Hops +Comparisons significantly outperforms the Hops +Constraints and just Hops.
The gain from Hops +Comparisons is most pronounced for Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, which has a low base F1 score for CofCA comparison questions.
So environment complexity axes can improve base models on question types on which they are particularly weak.
Second, linear hops remain the dominant axis of complexity for transfer on non-comparison categories.
Third, we find shortcutting behavior with Hops +Constraints—agents issue verbatim search queries rather than decomposing—and that actively hurts transfer ( Section B.1 ).
blocks.zh:
复杂斧头究竟在哪里帮助或伤害? 综合F1得分模糊了环境变体引入的物剂的行为变化.
在图6和图11中,我们按照CofCA和2Wiki MultihopQA基准的问题类别对性能进行分解,这些基准中包含问题类别标签(类别标签详情见A.6节)。
两者都有比较问题,我们各自的环境Hops + Comparisons 和Hops + Controlints 直接针对这些问题.
我们注意到三项意见。
首先,比较培训问题针对匹配的现实世界类别: Hops + Comparisons 显著优于 Hops + Controlints 而只是 Hops.
Hops + Comparisons的得分在Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct中最为突出,CofCA比较问题中其基础分数F1较低.
因此,环境复杂轴可以改进它们特别薄弱的问题类型的基础模型.
第二,线性跳动仍然是非比较性类别上转移的复杂性的主导轴.
第三,我们发现与Hops + Controlints 的短暂行为——代理发布逐字记录查询而不是解析——并积极伤害转移(B.1节)。

blocks.en:
Figure 6: F1 score deltas per question type of CofCA benchmark after fine-tuning on environment variants. We plot F1 score deltas on comparison and non-comparison questions: we calculate F1 score difference per question, average deltas for each category, and report the mean ± \pm standard error (paired) in percentage points.
Hops +Comparisons environment improves performance on evaluation comparison questions, but linear hops remains dominant otherwise.
blocks.zh:
图6:经过环境变体微调后,每问题类型COFCA基准的F1得分三角洲. 我们在比较和非比较问题上绘制F1得分三角洲:我们计算F1的得分差每问题,每类的平均得分三角洲,并报告平均值±\pm标准差(paired)以百分点表示.
Hops + Comparisons 环境在评价比较问题上提高了性能,但线性hop在其他方面仍然占主导地位.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We show that LLM search agents trained in PhantomEnvironments, with no humans or LLMs in the data pipeline, transfer to real-world multi-hop search.
Real training data wins where memorized knowledge helps, but its advantage narrows on benchmarks built from newer Wikipedia snapshots.
Ablating environment complexity reveals that linear hops drive most of the transfer, comparison questions target their matching real-world category, and constraint questions backfire by rewarding a verbatim-query shortcut.
In this work, we find rule-generated synthetic environments as a zero-marginal-cost and effective source of agent training data.
blocks.zh:
我们显示LLM搜索人员在幽灵环境(Phantom Environments)接受过训练,在数据管道中没有人类或LLMs,转移到现实世界的多跳搜索.
真正的训练数据赢得了记忆知识的帮助,但其优势却缩小了从更新的维基百科快照中构建的基准.
模拟环境的复杂性揭示了线性跳动驱动了大部分的转录,比较问题针对它们匹配的现实世界类别,通过奖励一个逐字记录快捷键来约束问题反射.
在这项工作中,我们发现规则生成的合成环境是一个零边际成本有效的剂培训数据来源.

blocks.en:
Limitations. Our complexity analysis invites further work on environment composition: given a known capability gap, can one read off a recipe of synthetic axes that closes it?
We use synthetic environments as standalone; blending them with real-world data, e.g., as mid-training data, is a natural next step.
Compute budgets limit us from training larger LLMs and evaluating on long-context and open-web benchmarks like BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2025c ) —all open directions.
blocks.zh:
限制。 我们的复杂性分析要求就环境组成问题开展进一步的工作:鉴于已知的能力差距,人们能否从合成轴的配方中读取一下,从而将其关闭?
我们把合成环境作为单独的;把它们与现实世界的数据混合在一起,例如作为训练中期的数据,是自然的下一步。
计算预算将限制我们培训较大的有限责任公司,并评价诸如浏览Comp-Plus(Chen等人,2025c)等长文和开放式网络基准——所有开放方向。

blocks.zh: A.1 指示提示

blocks.en: We use the following chat-style system and user prompts for all training and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们使用下列聊天式系统和用户提示来进行所有培训和评价。

blocks.en:
system:

You are a helpful and harmless assistant.

user:

Answer the given question using the search tool to retrieve relevant
information. Follow this process:
1. Reason about what you know and what you still need to find out with
the search tool. For complex questions, break them into sub-questions
and search for each part.
2. If you need more information, call the search engine:
<search> query </search>. Write focused, specific queries. If a query
returns unhelpful results, try a different phrasing or a more specific
sub-question.
3. Base your final answer only on information from the search results,
not on prior knowledge.
4. Once you have enough information, provide your answer inside
<answer> and </answer>. For multiple answers, use a comma-separated
list: <answer>Alice, Bob</answer>. Do not include explanations inside
the answer tags.

Question: {question}

系统 :

你是个有帮助和无害的助理

blocks.en:
Training dynamics and instability .
For a couple of real-world training data runs, we observed entropy spikes and training degeneration in Phi-4-mini-instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct models, often ≈ 50 % \approx 50\% into the run.
This occurred on 1 training seed for Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct on synthetic ablation Hops +Constraints as well.
In such cases, we report the prior saved policy checkpoint with the best held-out set performance.
We rule out PhantomEnvironments as the cause, as we observe model degeneracy in real-world training data and one-off training seeds.
Such RL training instability is observed in practice, even at frontier scale: MAI-Thinking-1 frequently observed crashes and restarted with heuristics ( Team, 2026 ) .
Identifying the cause is an interesting open research direction.

blocks.en:
At every search turn, the LLM policy queries a locally served dense retrieval index built with FAISS ( Johnson et al., 2019 ) .
We use exact (flat) search and return the top-3 passages for each query.
Each evaluation benchmark contributes its own retrieval corpus, constructed from the gold and distractor paragraphs accompanying its question set.
The one exception is FRAMES, for which we download Wikipedia articles at the June 2023 revision cutoff that matches the benchmark’s authoring snapshot, and chunk them into section-level passages.

blocks.en:
During training, both the synthetic and real-world corpora are encoded with intfloat/e5-base-v2 (768 dimensions) ( Wang et al., 2022 ) .
This is the same encoder used by Search-R1, so the training retriever is fixed across synthetic and real-world environments, ensuring that differences in downstream performance reflects the training data source.
blocks.zh:
在训练期间,合成体和现实体的蝎子都用intfloat/e5-base-v2(768维)编码(Wang等人,2022年).
这与Search-R1使用的编码器相同,因此训练检索器固定在合成和现实世界环境中,确保下游性能的差异反映训练数据源.

blocks.en:
At evaluation time we switch to a stronger encoder, Qwen3-Embedding-4B (2560 dimensions), and apply it uniformly across all evaluation benchmarks.
Prior work has noted that retriever quality at evaluation time is a major confound when comparing LLM agents, and recommend using the best available search retriever index ( Jin et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025c ) .
Therefore, we standardize evaluation on the high-quality Qwen3-Embedding-4B retriever, and isolate the significance of our results to the training setup alone.
In Tables 4 and 5 , evaluation results are slightly worse—across the board—when we use the training setup during evaluation.

blocks.en: A.4.1 An Improved Bidirectional Anchor Sampling
blocks.zh: A.4.1 改进后的双向锚地取样

blocks.en:
PhantomWiki’s default question sampler grounds relation chains from one
fixed end: it picks a starting entity and walks forward through
relations until the chain is fully instantiated, with the answer always
landing at the final position. This introduces a positional bias. Entities
that sit at the periphery of the knowledge graph (leaves of family trees,
people with few friends) are over-represented as answers, because they are
easy to reach as chain endpoints but rarely serve as starting points.
blocks.zh:
PhantomWiki 默认的问题采样器将关系链从一个中解析
固定端端: 它选择一个起始实体并走过
关系,直到链条完全即时化, 答案总是
降落在最后的阵地。 这引入了立场偏见。 实体
他们坐在知识图的边缘,
朋友不多的人)作为答案的比例过高,因为他们
作为链式终点很容易到达,但很少作为起点。

blocks.en:
We replace this with a bidirectional anchor sampling procedure
that allows the answer to occupy any position in the chain. The idea is
straightforward: instead of committing to a direction before walking, we
first choose an anchor point inside the chain and then extend outward in
both directions.

blocks.en: B.1 Shortcut Trajectories from Hops +Constraints-Trained Agents
blocks.zh: B.1 来自 Hops 的快捷轨道 + 约束- 训练代理

blocks.en:
In Figures 5 , 6 and 11 , we observed that Hops +Constraints environment showed worse real-world transfer than the other environment complexity axes.
We trace it to a shortcut that the Hops +Constraints environment unintentionally rewards during training.
A constraint such as a specific date of birth or occupation is information-rich: a single dense-retrieval query that pastes the entire question often surfaces the gold document directly, because the rare attribute alone narrows the candidate set.
The agent then never has to resolve the question chain one at a time, and can side-step question decomposition.
Once this works in training, the behavior carries over at test time.
We observe that the Hops +Constraints-trained agent issues the question verbatim as its first search on an overwhelming majority of real-world trajectories and almost always paraphrases the same query when retrieval fails.
Whereas, the Hops-trained agent decomposes questions and reasons explicitly between turns, recovering the correct answer more often.
We show one such trajectory pair verbatim below.
Real-world benchmarks rarely include the kind of information-rich attribute filters that make the shortcut work, explaining why Hops +Constraints shows worse real-world transfer.
blocks.zh:
在图5、图6和图11中,我们观察到,Hops + Contacts环境比其他环境复杂轴更糟糕地呈现出真实世界的转移。
我们追踪到一个捷径 跳跃+约束环境 无意中奖励培训。
诸如特定出生日期或职业之类的制约是信息丰富的:一个单一的密集检索查询,将整个问题粘贴在金色文件上往往直接浮出水面,因为仅稀有的属性会缩小候选集.
代理人然后从不需要一次解决一个问题链,也可以边步问题分解.
一旦这在训练中起作用,行为就会在测试时间延续.
我们注意到Hops + Controlints训练的代理 将问题逐字逐字发布, 作为它第一次搜索 绝大多数真实世界的轨迹,
而Hops训练的特工则在转弯之间明确分解问题和原因,更经常地恢复正确答案.

现实世界的基准很少包括那种信息丰富的属性过滤器,使得快捷键发挥作用,解释为什么Hops + Constructents显示更糟糕的真实世界传输.
